kill.rule: K1 .35 six-cube gate or scroll guard fails at BOTH 40k and 50k; K2 frontier veto (bridges > 1.20 x the C3 curve at matched coverage, resolved) at BOTH; K3 pooled 10k-50k paired delta at .35 with point < -0.030 AND upper bound < 0 vs F0 AND vs C3r (one early-band seed RMS beyond both comparators and beyond patch sampling); K4 technical. I: weighted term share < 0.01 of the committed total loss = inert, unmeasured, no resume. Single-milestone deltas are tabled, never decisive.

late_band.tie_margin_rule: max(0.005, 2 x |late_mean_F0 - late_mean_C3r|) = 0.012016 at T .35 (0.009862 at .30; 0.012 used at both). The 11 paired late deltas have SD 0.0191 with no visible lag-1 correlation, so the SE of an 11-milestone mean is 0.0058 and the margin is ~2 SE; +0.020 is ~3.4 SE and clears the margin by 0.008; +0.012 is the minimum detectable effect. The family 25-milestone margin (0.059) and 50k comparisons (early seed RMS 0.0299) cannot resolve +0.02.
late_band.rule: D1 late mean (.35) exceeds BOTH F0 (0.661331) and C3r (0.655322) late means by >= 0.012; D2 pooled late paired lower bounds > 0 vs both; D3 no reversal at .30 (both late-mean deltas > 0 and both pooled lower bounds > 0); D4 scroll guard >= 10/11, .35 gates >= 9/11 and at the selected milestone (best eligible >= 150k, ties later), frontier resolved and passed at the selected milestone; D5 Kaggle floors at the selected milestone without TTA; D6 PHerc0500P2 TopoScore paired vs F0@200k at the same T has lower bound > -0.010. promote = D1..D6; unresolved-positive = D2 and point > 0 without D1; else reject. H_topo (reported, never required): PHerc0500P2 TopoScore delta >= +0.010 with lower bound > 0.

thickening.rule: C1: at BOTH 40k and 50k, the .35 six-cube foreground ratio >= 1.10 x F0's sealed value at the same milestone, OR the thickness gate fails, OR the interior gate fails, OR the frontier veto fails -> P_sep = parent + separation 0.4 at the kill stage. A killed parent is replaced by P_sep; a surviving parent competes with P_sep by pooled delta vs F0 and only the better one resumes. Both thickening: P_sep is built on the one with the better pooled delta.

tail_lane.rule: C2: a surviving preservation arm at 50k has fixed-18 reference-skeleton coverage >= F0@50k + 0.02, a resolved passing frontier and a .35 foreground ratio <= 1.10 x F0@50k (continuity near teacher sheets is the lever), AND the operator drops the authorization file. Verdict: T_tail vs T_base pooled 5-milestone delta at .35 with point > 0 and lower bound > 0 and no K1/K2 = eligible for its own 250k prereg; never a ship claim.

continuation.rule: after the operator review pause: comparators(late) -> survivors resumed with --resume from their 50k commit to 250k -> late-band verdict -> seed-1204 replicate of the promoted arm (D1, D2, D4 on its own; effect = mean of both seeds' late deltas) -> ship check.
